title: Brew & Co Tumbler — Paid Launch
brand: Brand: Brew & Co — a matte-black 500ml vacuum-insulated stainless steel tumbler, tapered silhouette with a brushed-steel rim and a silicone grip ring, an engraved label reading "BREW & CO · 500ML" on the front, and a hero claim: keeps drinks hot for 8 hours or iced for 12
grade: Grade: high-key commercial product photography, crisp whites, soft seamless gradients, premium product glow, clean highlights, subtle film grain
craft: Craft: shot on a Hasselblad X2D medium format, 85mm f/2.8 lens, focus-stacked macro sharpness, softbox key light, white V-flat bounce fill

videos.camera: Locked-off medium close-up, slow push-in on a 50mm lens
videos.action: A hand in a charcoal sleeve lifts the tumbler toward camera; steam rises gently from the open lid
videos.setting: Bright minimalist kitchen at morning golden hour
videos.lighting: soft window light from the left, warm backlight rim
videos.audio: Dialogue: "Eight hours. Still hot." SFX: subtle lid click, warm room tone

videos.camera: 0-4s wide establishing on a desk; 4-9s dolly-in to medium close-up; 9-15s macro ECU on the rim
videos.action: Coffee is poured from the tumbler into a cup at 5s; at 12s the tumbler sits closed on the desk, steam visible
videos.setting: Modern home office at dusk, warm desk lamp glow
videos.lighting: mixed warm lamp light + soft window light from the right
videos.audio: Dialogue: "Made it at 8am. Still hot at 4pm." SFX: pour sound, gentle room ambience

videos.camera: Static macro ECU on the engraved label, then a quick pull-back
videos.action: The label "BREW & CO · 500ML" catches the light; the tumbler pulls back into focus on a white studio background
videos.audio: SFX: crisp metallic ring, soft whoosh
